description: 🧱 Mobile-first stack navigator framework with composable plugin system
vibe: Event-sourced mobile navigation with a plugin-first, type-safe core.
highlights: Event sourcing drives all state changes through domain events (Pushed, Popped, Replaced, etc.)
Immutable stack state updated via reducers, with side effects isolated in an effect system
Framework-agnostic core with React as the first integration, enabling future framework support
Config-first API design separates activity/route definitions from React components for optimal loading performance
Strict TypeScript typing with module augmentation via `declare module "@stackflow/config"` for activity parameters
assessment: This instruction file reflects a mature systems mindset: it treats navigation as an event-sourced state machine with clear separation between core logic, framework integration, and UI extensions. The emphasis on immutability, effect isolation, and plugin hooks creates a testable, extensible architecture that scales across hybrid app and webview use cases. The config-first API and strict typing show deliberate attention to performance and developer ergonomics without sacrificing type safety.
